mapper.select: SELECT pi.*, l.title, l.fnsku, l.compose_type, l.material_id, l.pack_qty, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(it.sku_qty) FROM ecom_inbound_item it JOIN ecom_inbound i ON i.id = it.inbound_id WHERE it.plan_item_id = pi.id AND i.status <> 'CANCELLED' AND it.part_main = 1), 0) AS shipped_qty FROM ecom_shipment_plan_item pi LEFT JOIN ecom_listing l ON l.id = pi.listing_id LEFT JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = l.material_id WHERE pi.plan_id = #{planId} ORDER BY pi.id
